title: Applying traditional and machine learning-based GWAS approaches for marker-trait identification in wheat.
summary: On a public winter-wheat dataset, Elastic Net, XGBoost, Random Forest and hybrid TSLRF were compared with traditional GWAS tools for plant height and thousand-kernel weight. Machine-learning models recovered some traditional associations and identified additional markers. Results are dataset- and trait-specific.
ai_technology: The study compares Elastic Net, XGBoost, Random Forest and hybrid TSLRF machine-learning GWAS on winter-wheat genotypes to identify marker-trait associations, alongside traditional GWAS tools.
organization: AIT Austrian Institute of Technology; BOKU University

evidence.tested: Using a winter-wheat dataset, the study compared Elastic Net, XGBoost, Random Forest and hybrid TSLRF with traditional GWAS tools. Machine-learning models recovered some conventional marker-trait associations and identified additional markers; the findings are limited to the studied traits and dataset.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established in the reviewed study.
